updateNotes.v1.3.0:
Hi Guys, a new update has appeared! From now on, every major update will come with new update notes to inform users about new changes.

**__NEW COMMANDS__**

`/redeem code` **ADMINS ONLY**: Redeems a code for you and the rest of the userbase!

`/redeem all`: Redeems *all* the available codes for you. This may take a while.

`/silent`: Hate the constant daily check-in and code redeem notifs? Use this command to turn them off! Running `/silent` again will turn them back on.
